strongest_angle: The Brooklyn District Attorney's office and the Virtual Currency Unit dismantled an industrial multinational crypto fraud network by shutting down 112 servers and 241 scam domains targeting Russian speakers.

key_facts.fact: The Brooklyn District Attorney's Office Virtual Currency Unit dismantled infrastructure of a multinational crypto investment scam that targeted Russian speakers by shutting down 112 servers and 241 scam domains.

The Brooklyn District Attorney's office disrupted a multinational cryptocurrency-scam network centered in Eastern Europe, shutting down 241 websites linked to crypto fraud that stole tens of millions of dollars from Americans.

The Brooklyn District Attorney's Office announced the takedown of hundreds of servers and domains used to defraud Russian speakers in the United States, dealing a significant blow to the international crypto scam operation.
